home.title: Custodian console
home.intro: Sign in with your custodian account to maintain streets and addresses in your jurisdiction.
home.loginFailed: Signing in did not complete. Please try again.

workspace.mapIntro: Streets maintained by {custodian} are highlighted. Select a street or building to propose a correction.
workspace.noCustodian: Your account is not assigned to a custodian yet.
workspace.legend: Highlighted lines are your streets; grey lines belong to other custodians.
workspace.selectHint: Select a street or building on the map.
workspace.selected: Describe what is wrong and what it should be.
workspace.summaryPlaceholder: e.g. The plate on the building shows number 5A.
workspace.noPersonalData: Do not include names, phone numbers or ID numbers of residents.
workspace.editorsOnly: Only custodian editors can submit corrections.

error.unauthorized: Your session has expired. Please sign in again.
error.forbidden: This is outside your jurisdiction or your role does not allow it.
error.target: Please select a street or building again.
error.summary: Please describe the correction in 3 to 500 characters.
error.houseNumber: House numbers are digits with an optional letter, e.g. 12 or 12A.
error.failed: The register could not be reached. Please try again.

inbox.title: Inbox
inbox.intro: Change requests in your jurisdiction waiting for a decision, oldest first. Nobody can approve their own request.
inbox.approversOnly: The inbox is for custodian approvers.
inbox.empty: Nothing is waiting for a decision.
inbox.unavailable: The register could not be reached. Please try again.
inbox.forbidden: This change request is outside your jurisdiction, or your role does not allow you to see it.
inbox.markerLegend: The dot marks the captured or proposed location; the highlighted building is the one the change refers to.
inbox.noLocation: This change has no location to show on a map.

diff.title: Changes
diff.empty: No field values change; see the description and the evidence.

evidence.title: Evidence
evidence.sha256: SHA-256 (taken on the device, verified on upload)
evidence.mockedDetail: The phone reported this location as coming from a mock location app. The capture was accepted; check the location against the photo before approving.

decision.title: Decision
decision.reasonPlaceholder: e.g. The photo does not show the plate. Please retake it.
decision.noPersonalData: Write what needs to change. Do not include names, phone numbers or ID numbers of residents.

blocked.own_request: You proposed this change. Under the four-eyes rule another approver must decide it.
blocked.not_approver: Only custodian approvers can decide change requests.
blocked.outside_jurisdiction: This change is outside your jurisdiction.
blocked.already_decided: This change request has already been decided.

error.unauthorized: Your session has expired. Please sign in again.
error.forbidden: You may not decide this request (four-eyes rule or jurisdiction).
error.conflict: Someone has already decided this request.
error.reason: Please write a reason of 3 to 500 characters.
error.failed: The register could not be reached. Please try again.
